statement: The record gives G-19 an access level of “open, cleared for publication,” but because it also specifies restricted-access consent for named participants’ genomes, I will hold the file rather than publish it.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer names the contradiction — "open, cleared for publication" conflicts with "restricted-access consent for named participants' genomes" — and refuses to publish, treating the open access level as invalid.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
